evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget.

observations.why: Stating a completed deliverable as fact supplies information to establish what was accomplished; no influence attempt on an audience is performed.

evidence.quote: Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.

observations.why: Citing a measured metric with a comparative superlative supplies facts and frames them as evidence of performance; the superlative carries a light rational-persuasion coloring.

evidence.quote: The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

observations.why: Asserting a causal factor as fact supplies information about what drove success; no audience-directed influence attempt is performed.
